summary: Defines two DNS resource record types, EUI48 and EUI64, for storing Ethernet-style hardware addresses in the DNS. It warns of serious privacy implications and says such addresses should not be published in the public DNS, intending the records for private namespaces.

eli5.summary: It adds DNS slots for the serial number on a network card, but warns not to put them where everyone can read.

questions: should mac addresses be published in dns
